definition: PermitsEvils g evils means g allows the evils picked out by the fixed predicate evils to be in his works. The collective readings separately require that this collection be nonempty. Permission is distinct from directly causing an evil, ability to prevent it, actual production of good, or moral justification.
note: Parameter semantics for explicit scope comparison, motivated by the pinned ad 1 wording. A source argument fixing the relation extension or connecting the collective and distributive relations would be needed to go beyond this interpretation; no such bridge is supplied here.
